text: Bha the Bargainhunter is a Xivilai merchant found in The Reaver Citadel.
Bhagruan gra-Dunk is an Orsimer member of the Mages Guild. She is part of the team studying the Glenumbra Moors.
Biiri Fanim is a Dunmer grocer in who sells her wares at the trading hall of Bleakrock Village.
Binayne Nelvani is a Dunmer merchant. She sells her wares at her stall, Nelvani's Supply Tent, in Tal'Deic Fortress.
Big Rabbu is a Breton member of the Fighters Guild part of the group that went in Spindleclutch. He went mad after being exposed to the whispers for too long.
Bendralas is a Bosmer member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in the Hollow City.
Bervid is a Nord found in Ufgel's Bathhouse and Laundry in the city of Orsinium. He has no unique dialogue.
Bilami the Caravaneer is a Redguard caravaneer found just outside the northern gates of Anvil, Gold Coast. She owns a horse named Sojourn.
Bellucia Leraud is a Breton found in the Great Chapel of Dibella in Anvil, Gold Coast.
Berjac Garick is a Breton found in the east halls of Anvil Castle in Anvil, Gold Coast. He cannot be interacted with.
Bernice Hastien is a Breton residing in the Hastien House in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra.
Berserker Denmother is a Nord Acrobat residing in the Gronn ice cave situated southwest of Lake Fjalding in the region of Isinfier Plains. She is the leader of the Berserkers.
Bellulor Chatterbeak is a Bosmer found at outlaws refuges in the cities of Marbruk, Shornhelm and Stormhold.
Belwanril is a Bosmer female prisoner residing in Abah's Landing in Hew's Bane.
Berjamund Beauchamp is a Breton patron of the Dusklight Inn in Hoarfrost Downs.
Bernetta is a Breton member of the Saltwalker Militia. She is found at their camp in the Alik'r Desert.
Berrice Notte is a Breton archeologist under the employ of Narsis Dren. She is found exploring and cataloguing at the Exile's Barrow. After the quest is completed, she can be found in Orsinium.
Belyn Raviro is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Mournhold.
Beran Larocque is a Breton priest residing at the old wayshrine of Akatosh in Cyrodiil. Just like the couple at the next shrine, Beran Larocque will disappear after completion of Pious Intervention.
Bergitte Snowpeak is a Nord brewer residing at Voljar's Meadery, west of Windhelm.
Beovar is a Nord found at Leaping Frog Sundries in Abah's Landing.
Benjor is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed at the Northern Morrowind Gate.
Bertis Benethran is a Dunmer magister of the Mages Guild residing in Sadrith Mora, on Vvardenfell. He can be found at their local camp.
Berithor is a Bosmer drunkard residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. He is located in The Rested Kwama tavern.
Berrammai is a Dunmer farmer residing in Ald'ruhn. She remains to witness the Ashlander rituals commemorating Skar's defeat. She is an Ashlander of the Ahemmusa Tribe. She has no unique interactions.

Berne Clan Reavers are generic Imperial vampire berserkers residing in Galom Daeus, Vvardenfell, in . They are vampires, and a member of the Berne Clan. This enemy is always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no Disguises available to avoid combat.
Bidsi is a Guar belonging to Ral Savani. She is found near Muriman, Munaea, and Sarnibi, who are in the slums close to the Mages Guild bridge in Kragenmoor.
Bellona Novatian is an Imperial Moth Priest found at the Temple of the Ancestor Moths within Cyrodiil. She has a great dislike for the three Alliances for stealing the Elder Scrolls.
Bindabi is a Khajiit Dagi beggar found near Kashraska's House in Rimmen. She is too weak to work, stemming from complications with the Knahaten flu. The Vestige can help her with a 69 donation.
Bijum-Loh is an Argonian member of the Black-Tongue Tribe found at the Glade of Chimes in Bright-Throat Village, Murkmire.
Belrengar is a Nord residing in the Gladiator's Quarters outside of Solitude.
Biknuk is an Orsimer in who works at the Northern High Rock Gate, Cyrodiil.
Bijum-Ta is an Argonian alchemist found in Marshland Market in Lilmoth.
Bezjhan is a Khajiit member of the Elsweyr Defense Force located at the Defense Force Outpost and later Sleepy Senche Mine, Northern Elsweyr, in .
Beragon is a character located in various places in and its DLCs. He is the brother of Eveli Sharp-Arrow.
Binsora-la is a Khajiit residing in the Slag Town Outlaws Refuge.
Bivale Teneran is a Dunmer merchant who owns a fine clothing store in the Ald'ruhn Manor District in Morrowind.
Birer Indaram is a Dunmer living in Molag Mar, Morrowind. He is a Deputy General with the Buoyant Armigers, and is the highest-ranking member of the Tribunal Temple at the city's Armigers Stronghold.
Black Brugo is the leader of the infamous Black Bows bandit group of Leyawiin.

Bittneld the Curse-Bringer is a Nord and is the Guard Captain of the Chorrol Guard, who can be found patrolling the streets of Chorrol or in Castle Chorrol's guard barracks. In spite of his position as an officer of the law, he will not try to arrest the Hero when they have a bounty.

Bjalfi the Contemptible is a Nord who lives in Fort Strand near the city of Anvil. After his marriage, he left his wife, Maeva the Buxom, to take up with the local Marauder band, residing in Fort Strand. His ex-wife Maeva lives on Whitmond Farm, which is very close to the Anvil main gate. When he left, he took her family heirloom, Rockshatter, an enchanted Dwemer mace.
Birard Adrognese is a Breton living in Ebonheart. He is also a member of the Imperial Legion.
Bjartur is a Nord prisoner found in Solitude. She is locked up inside the Castle Dour Dungeon for supporting the Stormcloaks.
Birama Andaram is a Dunmer Archer. She can be found in the cave Pinsun, with seven other smugglers.
Bjornolfr is a deceased Nord whose corpse can be found beneath Hrodulf's House.
Black Dart Gilur is a Dunmer commoner and member of the Black Dart Gang who resides with some of his fellow gang members in the Temple Sewers West beneath Mournhold Temple in Mournhold.
Black-Silk-Earth is an Argonian grocer residing in Davon's Watch in the region of Stonefalls.
Black Bessie is a champion of the Toothmaul Gully public dungeon. It can be found with Thek Elf-Stabber. Killing this creature counts towards the "Enforcer of Toothmaul Gully" achievement.
Bitten-Once-Shy is an Argonian tailor residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. She has a stall at the market near the docks, where she sells various clothing items.
Black Dart Adren is a Dunmer commoner who lives in the Temple Sewers West of Old Mournhold with other members of the Black Dart Gang.
Bjorynolf is a Nord in who is being held captive by the Frostedge Bandits at their camp on Bleakrock Isle. After being freed he can be found in Bleakrock Village.
Bisquelas the Bard is an Orsimer bard residing in Wayrest, Stormhaven. He is performing and singing his songs to all visitors in the Merchant District.

Black Dart Urvyn is a Dunmer commoner in . He lives in the Temple Sewers West of Old Mournhold with other members of The Black Dart Gang. He and his fellow gang members mugged Narisa Adus and killed her husband.

Black Dart Draren is a Dunmer commoner in . He lives in the Temple Sewers East of Old Mournhold and is a member of the Black Dart Gang, the only one not found inside or near their hideout in Old Mournhold: Temple Sewers West. He and his fellow gang members mugged Narisa Adus and killed her husband.

Black Dart Malar is a Dunmer commoner in . He lives in the Temple Sewers West of Old Mournhold and is a member of the Black Dart Gang. He and the rest of the gang members mugged Narisa Adus and killed her husband. He has a crate on a ledge in the gang's hideout that contains excellent loot, including Adamantium Boots.

Blackroot Enchanters are Undead members of the Bosmeri clan of Blackroot in . They are hostile towards the Vestige, unless they wear a disguise. There is no known disguise that the Vestige can wear to avoid hostile encounters with this faction. Enchanters wield a Barbaric Style steel dagger, and wear a mix of Primal, Barbaric, and Wood Elf Style Medium Armor that are very distressed and muddy. The armor typically consists of bracers, boots, a jerkin and a hood.

Blackroot Deadeyes are Undead members of the Bosmeri clan of Blackroot in . They are hostile towards the Vestige, unless they wear a disguise. There is no known disguise that the Vestige can wear to avoid hostile encounters with this faction. Deadeyes wield Oak Bosmer Style Bows, and wear a mix of Primal, Barbaric, and Wood Elf Style Medium Armor that are very distressed and muddy. The armor typically consists of bracers, boots, a jerkin and occasionally a helmet or hood.
Bishalus is an Argonian fisherman residing in the region of Bal Foyen. She is the quest giver for the quest, "The Bard of Hounds."
Bizinda is a Khajiit chef and slave. She is working at The Sugar-Rot Slop House in the pens of Kragenmoor.
Birgitta is a character in . She can be found in Delfran's Hideout. Once rescued, she will appear in Azra's Crossing.
Birila is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. She is found at their branch in Hissmir.
Bishanti is a Khajiit armorer residing in the city of Velyn Harbor. She sells her wares at her stall, Polished Protection, at the Traders Crescent.
Bisussah is a Khajiit enchanter and a member of the Mage Guild. She operates her stall, Bisussah's Enchanted Enclosure, out of their branch in Rawl'kha.
Bivala Aralen is a Dunmer merchant. She sells her wares at her stall, By The Three, Buy From Me, at the merchants' circle in Eyevea.
Bixitleesh is an Argonian guild trader part of the group of outlaws found underneath Shornhelm.
Biya-daro is a Khajiit part of the gang found inside the outlaws refuge underneath Rawl'kha.
Bizahad is a Khajiit member of the Mages Guild. He is found on Eyevea.
Bjaron Bitterblade is a Nord stablemaster working in Windhelm.
Bjorick is a Nord found in Hrogar's Hold. He is the son of Hrogar and Edwina, and Gar's brother.
Bjoruld Snowpeak is a Nord and Roruld Snowpeak's brother. He is found drunk at Voljar's Meadery.
Black-Scale is an Argonian member of the Undaunted found at Coin Brothers' Cornerclub, in Stormhold. The Vestige can buy him a drink as part of This One's On Me achievement.
Birkhu the Bold is a Khajiiti merchant-by-profession, patron of Skalar's Hostel in Orsinium. He offers cursory information regarding the Dwemer ruin of Nyzchaleft.
Bivale Dreleth is a Dunmer residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Bizuruna is a Khajiit found inside the castle of Anvil. She cannot be interacted with.
Bittergreen the Wild is a named guar that appears in Caravan Crest, Deshaan.
Bivale Moren is a Dunmer who can be found in Kvatch. She cannot be interacted with.
Bizazan is an Imperial member of the Order of the Hour. He is found at the Enclave of the Hourglass.
Bizurr is a Khajiit member of the Fighters Guild. He is part of the team held captive by the daedra at the Tower of Lies.
Black Dagger Marksman is a generic character residing in a number of locations in Cyrodiil.
Black Dagger Archer is a generic character residing in a number of locations in Cyrodiil.
Black Dagger Brigands are generic characters found in Cyrodiil, in a number of locations.
Black Dagger Enforcer is a generic character residing in a number of locations in Cyrodiil.
Blackheart Deckhand is a character residing in Blackheart Haven. They are also a skeleton.
Blackheart Frightener is a character residing in Blackheart Haven. They are also a skeleton.
Blackheart Bonelord is a character residing in Blackheart Haven. They are also a skeleton.
Birgitha is a Nord member of the Stonefire Cult. She is part of the invasion forces that took over Dune.
Birstagg is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact and a Tel Var armorer. He is found at the Ebonheart Pact Base within Harena Hypogeum.
Black Snail Archer is a generic character residing in Pinsun cave in Vvardenfell, Morrowind. They are part of the Black Snails faction.
Black Snail Assassin is a generic character residing in Vvardenfell. They are part of the Black Snails faction.
Black Snails Ravager is a generic character residing in Vvardenfell. They are part of the Black Snails faction.
Black Snail Soldier is a generic character residing in Vvardenfell. They are part of the Black Snails faction.

The Black Dart Bruiser is a generic member of The Black Darts residing in Zainsipilu, in Vvardenfell. They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available disguises that can be used to avoid combat with them.

The Black Dart Drudge is a generic member of The Black Darts residing in Zainsipilu, in Vvardenfell. They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available disguises that can be used to avoid combat with them.

The Black Dart Marksman is a generic member of The Black Darts residing in Zainsipilu, in Vvardenfell. They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available disguises that can be used to avoid combat with them.

The Black Dart Stalker is a generic member of The Black Darts residing in Zainsipilu, in Vvardenfell. They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available disguises that can be used to avoid combat with them.

The Black Dart Stitcher is a generic member of The Black Darts residing in Zainsipilu, in Vvardenfell. They are always hostile towards the Vestige, and there are no available disguises that can be used to avoid combat with them.
Bipbip is a tame fennec fox which accompanies Inngyrr in Davon's Watch.
Bitterhand Brute is a member of the Bitterhand Bandits in Rivenspire.
Black Wake Voidbringers are generic members of the Black Wake clan residing in the Waterworks in Shimmerene, Summerset.
Bizdar is a Khajiit who appears outside of Rimmen in Northern Elsweyr. He is a Battlegrounds Merchant who works in the Battle-Ready Market, part of the Rimmen Battlegrounds Camp.
Bishu Taia is a Khajiit beggar residing in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr. She has no unique dialogue.
Bishaba Basement-Dweller is a Khajiit who lives in the basement of the Goiter's Gulp in The Stitches, Northern Elsweyr. She wields a greatsword and reacts violently to trespassing.
Bizaku is a Khajiit ranch hand in the Prowl. He can be found working for Numaia at her ranch, near the hunting grounds.
Bjormund Wind-Strider is a character in that is a part of the Alternative Armors – Dragon Plate Creation Club content.

Blind Moth Priests are Imperials who are members of the Order of the Ancestor Moths, normally residing in either the Temple of the Ancestor Moths or in the libraries of White-Gold Tower. These priests guard the Elder Scrolls as well as the deeper parts of the Temple of the Ancestor Moths where they reside. In combat they typically wield an Akaviri Katana or Dai-Katana.

Blatta Hateria is an Imperial living in Ebonheart. She identifies herself as a Pauper who makes a living by fishing with her fishing boat. Later in the main quest it is revealed that she is allied with the Dissident Priests.
Blighted Cliff Racer is a creature in . They are a variation of Cliff Racer.

Blackroot Warriors are Undead members of the Bosmeri clan of Blackroot in . They are hostile towards the Vestige, unless they wear a disguise. There is no known disguise that the Vestige can wear to avoid hostile encounters with this faction. Warriors wield steel barbaric style swords, and wear a mix of Primal, Barbaric, and Wood Elf Style Medium Armor that are very distressed and muddy. The armor typically consists of bracers, boots, jack and helmet or hood.
Blanden Grizzle is a thief in . He can be found in Delfran's Hideout, he asks the Hero to get him some juice.
Blademaster Qariar is a Redguard warrior and friend of Baron Alard Dorell found in Northpoint.
Blaise Pamarc is a Breton member of the Mages Guild investigating the ruins of Aphren's Hold.
Blasius is the Breton innkeeper of the Crossroads Tavern, in Belkarth.
The Blasphemous Priest is a Nord contractor for the quest "The Dark Brotherhood Forever." He resides in the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun.
The Blacksap Assassin is a character residing in Cormount, in . This enemy is a member of the Blacksap Rebellion, and opposes the Dominion.
Blackwater Deadeye is a generic Deadeye residing in several locations in .
The Blacksap Recruit is a Bosmer residing in Cormount, in . This enemy is a member of the Blacksap Rebellion, and opposes the Dominion.
The Blacksap Ritualist is a Bosmer residing in Cormount, in . This enemy is a member of the Blacksap Rebellion, and opposes the Dominion.
The Blacksap Sharpshooter is a Bosmer residing in Cormount, in . This enemy is a member of the Blacksap Rebellion, and opposes the Dominion.
The Blacksap Swordsmaster is a Bosmer residing in Cormount, in . This enemy is a member of the Blacksap Rebellion, and opposes the Dominion.
Blighttooth is a hostile Dunmer zombie residing in Pothole Caverns in Cyrodiil.

Boethiah (Daedric script, ), among other names, is the Daedric Prince of deceit, conspiracy, murder, treachery, sedition, torture and cruelty who rules over the realm of Attribution's Share and whose sphere is the unlawful overthrow of authority. A violent Daedric Prince, Boethiah is known for their enjoyment in the suffering of mortals, and to be involved in "hidden or secret plots involving power or death." They are worshiped by the Dunmer, who count them among the Three Good Daedra in their pantheon. They can be summoned on the 2nd of Sun's Dusk.
Boderi Farano is a Dunmer, and a Journeyman Mysticism trainer who can be found most often at the Mystic Archives of the Arcane University.

Boldrisa Andrano is a Dunmer agent and an oathman of House Redoran. Boldrisa spends most of her time in her house in the Redoran Council Hall in Ald'ruhn. She is a medium skill trainer in Short Blade, Light Armor, and Sneak skills.
Blubamka is the Queen of Rihad residing in the Rihad Palace, Hammerfell. Blubamka plays a major role in the main quest of .
Boldon is a Redguard commoner and a refugee from Kvatch residing in the Kvatch: Refugee Camp.

Bogdub gra-Gurakh is a Orc Guard living in Fort Darius Imperial Legion base in Gnisis, Morrowind. The base is named after General Darius, who also lives in Gnisis. She is a member of the Imperial Legion.

The Boar is a creature found in Cyrodiil. They're fairly rare compared to most other animals, and usually only one is encountered at a time. The boar is among the opponents the Grand Champion of the Arena may choose to fight.
Blossom is a unique Paint Horse that belongs to Dar-Ma of Chorrol. It is weaker and smaller than any other horse and can only be stolen.
Bogrum gro-Galash is an Orsimer who runs The Lonely Suitor Lodge in Bravil. He rents beds for 10 and sells food and a few bottles of wine.
Blue Team Gladiator is a Dunmer in who is always present in the Arena Bloodworks, either practicing his archery or hand to hand skills.
Bolrin is a Bosmer merchant living in Ebonheart on the Ascadian Isles on Vvardenfell, Morrowind.
Bolar is an Orsimer resident of the Orc Stronghold, Narzulbur. She is the oldest member of the community and thus is believed to be the wisest.
Bolgeir Bearclaw is a Nord warrior in Solitude and the Housecarl of Jarl Elisif the Fair.
Bolfrida Brandy-Mug is a Nord farmer in who is located at Brandy-Mug Farm outside Windhelm and is the owner of it. The Dragonborn can harvest crops for her and sell them to her.
Bolayn Rethan is a Dunmer battlemage and House Brother of House Hlaalu who resides in his shack on the Dren Plantation in Morrowind.
Bodean is a Redguard Healer residing in Ashalmawia east of Ald Velothi in the West Gash. He is hostile and will attack the Nerevarine upon sight.
Bols Indalen is a Dunmer smith who resides in the Craftsmen's Hall at the district of Godsreach, Mournhold.
Blue-Eyes is an Argonian residing outside the Tribunal Temple in Mournhold.
Bokeeus is an Argonian carpenter working in the Dhalmora Hall of Merchants in Dhalmora at her stall, Sappy Saw Woodworking.
Blodrat is an Orsimer patron of the Oak and Crosier in Chorrol.
Blue-Scale is an Argonian traveling merchant found south of Stormhold.

Boatswain Qa'jhirr is a Khajiit member of the Renrijra Maor. She is found near her boat in Alten Corimont. Once the Aldmeri Dominion threat in Alten Corimont has been dealt with, she offers her services by transporting the Vestige back and forth between the town and Dominion landing site.
Bogodug is an Orsimer refugee found in Camp Tamrith in Rivenspire.
Bolfrosti Deep-Shade is a Nord and the innkeeper of the Shadehome Inn, in Riften. She is married to Regold Deep-Shade.
Bloodwraith Caitiff is a type of Dremora that appears in . They have a chance to drop Daedra Husks or Daedra Hearts.
Bloodwraith Kynval is a type of Dremora that appears in . They have a chance to drop Daedra Husks or Daedra Hearts.
Bloodmaw is a blood-thirsty Durzog found in the Bonesnap Ruins.
Bloodthorn Zombie is a zombie that appears in . They are summoned by different Reachmen cults, such as Bloodthorn Cult and Dark Witnesses.
Boagog is an Orsimer chef found working in the Tumnosh Longhouse in the Tumnosh Clanhold near the Graystone Quarry. He is a member of the Tumnosh Clan.
Boatswain Faranya is an Altmer member of the Fist of Thalmor crew in that has been taken hostage by the Sea Vipers camped at Jode's Pocket.
Boderi Sedri is a Dunmer found inside the Tribunal Temple of Mournhold.
Boderia Ienith is a Dunmer of House Hlaalu found in the Obsidian Gorge.
Boldrisa Devani is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. She is stationed in Fort Virak.

Bolug Idolus is an Orsimer outlaw in . She has recently fled to a dungeon in order to escape arrest. Depending on the player's alliance, she can be found in the delve of the alliance's territory. In the Aldmeri Dominion, she is found at Naril Nagaia in Greenshade, and has protection from the Veiled Heritance. In the Daggerfall Covenant, she is found at Orc's Finger Ruins in Rivenspire, and has protection from the Bitterhand Bandits. In the Ebonheart Pact, she is found at Chid-Moska Ruins in Shadowfen. If one has begun the game in Vvardenfell, she will be found in Pulk.
Bolgen is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.
Bolayn Andalor is a Dunmer innkeeper residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. He is the owner and proprietor of The Rested Kwama tavern.
Bolnora Romavel is a Dunmer navigator residing in Vos, Vvardenfell.
Bolgrul is an Orsimer member of the Undaunted residing in the enclaves in Elden Root, Mournhold, and Wayrest. He offers daily delve quests.
Bloody Knoll Wardens are generic Orsimer wardens residing in Shatul Range, Wrothgar.
Bloody Hand Hunter is a goblin in that is a member of the Bloody Hand Tribe.
Bloody Hand Savage is a goblin in that is a member of the Bloody Hand Tribe.
Bloody Hand Skirmisher is a goblin in that is a member of the Bloody Hand Tribe.
Bolaag is an Orsimer residing in Shornhelm. She can be found around the Market Plaza, juggling knives at various locations.

Bolu is a Naga residing in Lilmoth, Murkmire. He offers the Vestige one of six Death-Hunt quests available each day in which a boss in Murkmire must be defeated. He is the author of Crafting Motif 69: Dead-Water Style.
Bolefin is an Bosmer fence found in the Rimmen Outlaws Refuge in Rimmen, Northern Elsweyr. He runs the Prowl and Profit stall.
Blooming Spriggan is a creature in that is a part of the Forgotten Seasons Creation Club content.
Blue God is a character in that is a part of the Goblins Creation Club content.

Bolvyn Venim is a Dunmer. He was a Councilor and Archmaster of House Redoran. Bolvyn is very suspicious of anyone who is an outlander. He is killed by the Nerevarine during his quest to become the Hortator of House Redoran.
Bolyn Elval is a Dunmer archer residing in the Arobar Guard Quarters, in the city of Ald'ruhn. He is a hireling of House Redoran, serving as a guard of Miner Arobar.

Borgas of Winterhold was High King of Skyrim in the First Era and the last of the Ysgramor Dynasty. He is perhaps best known for outlawing the old Nordic pantheon of deities, and for being one of Marukh's chief supporters. He is also believed to have been the last monarch to wear the legendary Jagged Crown.
Borissean is a Redguard who offers his services as an advanced spell merchant located in the Praxographical Center of the Arcane University, in the Imperial City.
Borba gra-Uzgash is an Orsimer trader and the owner of Borba's Goods and Stores in Cheydinhal.
Bothiel is a Bosmer mage and astronomer residing in the Arcane University, where she takes care of the Orrery. She can usually be found in the Arch-Mage's Lobby.
Bolwing is a Bosmer commoner and beggar who lives in Crucible.
Bongond is a Dunmer ostler who sells Chestnut horses at the North Country Stables.
Boroneth is a Bosmer who worships the Daedric Prince Hircine and can be found at his shrine.
Botrir is a Nord Barbarian who resides in the Grazelands of Morrowind. Botrir can be found outside of Indoranyon. He will be found in his underwear mourning the loss of his axe, Widowmaker.
Borgakh the Steel Heart is an Orsimer warrior found in the Orc Stronghold of Mor Khazgur, west of Solitude. She is the daughter of Chief Larak. She can also serve as a follower and can be married.
Borri is an Elder Nord and one of the Greybeards the Dragonborn meets at High Hrothgar.
Borvir was an apprentice mage at the College of Winterhold. His corpse can be found at Journeyman's Nook, adjacent a bandit and a named dagger.
Bothela is a Breton Reachwoman alchemist who lives in Markarth.
Borkul the Beast is an Orsimer guard found in Cidhna Mine. He is a member of the Forsworn, and serves as Madanach's bodyguard. He is also the only Orc member in the Druadach branch of the Forsworn.
Bolund is a Nord lumberjack found in Falkreath. He is in charge of the lumber mill and is the brother of Solaf, the owner of Gray Pine Goods in Falkreath.
Boti is a Nord farmer in who is located in Ivarstead tending to her crops. She is the mother of Fastred and the wife of Jofthor.
Borgny is a Nord miner in who works at the Quicksilver Mine in Dawnstar.
Bolvus Ieneth is a Dunmer archer who resides in Ansi in the Azura's Coast region of Morrowind. He is a bandit and will be hostile to the Nerevarine.
Boryn Varen is a Dunmer witchhunter, and resides in the cave of Sanabi.
The Bosmer Thief is an Altmer who stole the Brush of True Paint from Rythe Lythandas and used it to create some paint trolls to protect him, but they instead killed him.
Both gro-Durug is an Orsimer Pawnbroker, and merchant who can be found at either Wolverine Hall or Dirty Muriel's Cornerclub in Sadrith Mora. He is a member of the Thieves Guild.
Borug gro-Lazgarn is an Orsimer barbarian residing in Sinsibadon. He will be hostile towards the Nerevarine and attack on sight.
Borghak is an Orsimer who resides in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai.

Bosriel Skeffington was the young daughter of Turala Skeffington, and was born in 1E 2920 with the help of an Ayleid, or Wild Elf. Bosriel was born to an ex-Redoran member called Turala. Born in the Heartlands of Cyrodiil, she was delivered with the help of an Ayleid, a race of Mer thought to he extinct. Bosriel was killed in an Orsimer raid on the Skeffington Farm. After her death, her mother, who believed the Duke of Mournhold had order the raid, destroyed Mournhold with an army from Mehrunes Dagon.
Bonetooth is a creature that appears in . It is a boss Kagouti located in Triple Circle Mine.
Borzog is an Orsimer residing in Alcaire Castle, located inside the Old Goat Inn.
Bondileth is a Bosmer member of the Fighters Guild residing in Skywatch, Auridon.
Borchon is a Bosmer found at the College of Aldmeri Propriety in Auridon.
Bonelord Ethruin is a Bosmer located in Bone Orchard in Grahtwood.
Bonwyn Fireforge is a Nord working at the Royal Bazaar in Mournhold.
Bothisii is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. She is found at their branch in Mournhold.
Borz gro-Othmog is an Orsimer residing in the Craglorn city of Belkarth. He cannot be interacted with.
Borogilmith is a Bosmer member of the Fighters Guild, and is located at Sentinel, Vulkwasten, and Fort Amol during various points in the Fighters Guild questline.
Borynil Dalas is a Dunmer member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their branch in Kragenmoor.
Bonohild Windtorn is a Nord residing at her family home in Riften.
Borald is a Nord drunkard found in the Hall of the Dead in Windhelm.
Borgdorga is an Orsimer patron of the Screaming Mermaid in Port Hunding. She has no unique dialogue.
Bormolg gro-Grush is an Orsimer member of the Orsimer war-band that took over the Cradlecrush Giants in Eastmarch.
Borolg is an Orsimer and the leader of a Daggerfall Covenant contingent trying to take over the village of Lukiul Uxith in .
Borrows-Trouble is an Argonian found in her house in Stormhold.
Bothus Giralvel is a Dunmer magus and a member of the Ebonheart Pact. He sells his wares in the Merchant House at the Northern Morrowind Gate.
Bottild is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. He is found at the barracks in Fort Amol.
Borwiian is a Bosmer residing in the town of Vulkwasten, Malabal Tor.
Borzighu the Tidy Tailor is an Orsimer clothier and proprietor of Coldsnap Clothiers in the city of Orsinium.
Borbuz is an Orsimer leatherworker residing in the city of Orsinium. He is the proprietor of Orcish Pride Outfitters underneath Haggler's Bluff.
Borab the Mason is an Orsimer residing in the city of Orsinium. He is the Head Mason in charge of the reconstruction of Orsinium.
Boneshaper Gravesingers are Reachman member of the Boneshaper Clan. They can be found in a number of locations throughout The Rift.
Boneshaper Witchmen are Reachman members of the Boneshaper Clan. They can be found in a number of locations throughout The Rift.
Borcholim is a Bosmer and one of the potential assassination targets assigned by Speaker Terenus at the Smuggler's Den.
Bolvus Bels is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is found wounded at Iliath Temple, where he is tended to by the priests living there.
Bosun Idroni is a Dunmer accompanying Captain One-Eye on her journey into Coldharbour.
Vakhtang is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed at Fort Virak. He has no unique dialogue.
Borasad is a Redguard found in Exile's Barrow, overlooking the barrow from his small camp's perch.
Boryn Andrilo is a Dunmer laborer residing in Seyda Neen on Vvardenfell. He is the husband of Idera Andrilo and lives in Andrilo's House. This character does not have any unique dialogue.
Bontilf is a Nord part of the Saltwalker Militia. She is found at their camp in the Alik'r Desert.
Bolvyn Vidron is a Dunmer residing in Molag Mar on Vvardenfell.
Bonesnap Assassins are Goblins that appear in . They are members of the Bonesnap Tribe, and can be found in and around Bonesnap Ruins.
Barfel Hammerheart is a Nord drunkard and member of the Clockwork Apostles residing in Slag Town in the Brass Fortress, Clockwork City.
Bor is a thief and a member of Thieves Guild. He gives a player the Thieves Guild quests.

Bothamul is an Orsimer Lieutenant with the Ropefish residing in Sadrith Mora, Vvardenfell. He agrees to smuggle Eoki and several other slaves out of Morrowind in exchange for a considerable sum of gold during the quest "The Heart of a Telvanni."
Borgnurakh is an Orsimer gatherer located in Borbgur's House, Orsinium.
Borbgur is an Orsimer gatherer residing in her house, located in the outskirts of the city of Orsinium.
is an Orsimer hunter located in a camp southwest of the Icy Shore Wayshrine. He was part of Orgotha's hunting party.
Bosmer Adventurer is a Bosmer adventurer who has been captured by the Trolls found in the Troll's Toothpick. She appears near other players instead of Gluineth when they are completing the quest.
Bond-Guru Topeth is an Argonian member of the Bright-Throat Tribe responsible for this year's bonding ceremony. He can be found in the Bright-Throat Village.
Boski Broom-Lover is a Nord beggar who works at the Goiter's Gulp in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr. He has no unique dialogue.
Borki is a Redguard noblewoman in who resides in the court of Castle Sentinel.

Borgusilus Malier was an Imperial historian who lived during the First and Second Eras. He is primarily known for proposing a theoretical explanation for the disappearance of the Dwemer, a mystery that has perplexed scholars for millennia.

Bralas Mels is a Dunmer Bard. He works for and is associated with the criminal organization Camonna Tong. He spends most of his time in the Council Club with the rest of his brethren in the Camonna Tong.

Braeloque was a poet who wrote, sometime before the events that took place in , that "To find the facts, the wisest always look first to the fiction." He is mentioned for this quote in The Fall of the Usurper.

Brendan the Persistent was an author who wrote about the Black Marsh and the Argonians who lived there. He wrote the following about it: During his last expedition into the deeper swamps of Black Marsh, he disappeared.
Breech-Star is an Argonian slave living in Molag Mar, Morrowind.

Bradon Lirrian was the husband of Erline Lirrian. They lived in his house, which is located off of the west wall within Bruma. He was suspected to be a vampire and was killed by the vampire hunter Raynil Dralas in the quest "A Brotherhood Betrayed."
Branwen is a Redguard and can be found outside of the Arena training with an Argonian named Saliith. She is the alleged daughter of Owyn, the Blademaster.

Brellin is a Bosmer crusader who arrives at the Priory of the Nine in the hope he may become a Knights of the Nine and serve Auri-El, also known as Akatosh. He states that he came from Silvenar, in Valenwood, and can offer nothing but his skill with the blade. If he is accepted into the Knights, he will change into the standard Knight of the Nine Cuirass and ready for the attack on Umaril. After the battle, he will return to the simple life at the Priory. When he isn't in the chapel praying, he can be found in the garden tending the crops, or in the back training.
Bremman Senyan is an Imperial warrior and one of the two surviving Knights of the Thorn the Hero of Kvatch will find inside the Cheydinhal Oblivion Gate.
Brenuin is a Redguard beggar and drunkard who lives in the city of Whiterun.

Brelyna Maryon is a Dunmer mystic in who is an apprentice at the College of Winterhold, in Winterhold. She is involved in two of the first quests for the college. Brelyna becomes a candidate for marriage and a possible follower after the Dragonborn assists her with an experiment. She resides in the Hall of Attainment, where she has her quarters.
Brand-Shei, born Brandyl, is a Dunmer shopkeeper residing in Riften, where he sells miscellaneous goods from his stall during waking hours.
Braith is a Redguard child living in the Wind District of the city of Whiterun.
Braig is a Breton Reachman who is imprisoned in Cidhna Mine and a member of the Forsworn rebellion.
Brelas is a Bosmer pawnbroker and servant working at the Thalmor Embassy. She serves Colovian Brandy to Elenwen's party guests. Brelas expresses a strong dislike for Erikur, a Thane of Solitude.
